{{Quote|Gletch sent you, didn't he? I've dealt with your kind before. Just try and take me, slug!|Greenfinger|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Greenfinger''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] thief who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He did business with [[Farious Gletch]] in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]].

[[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], Greenfinger tried to skip town without paying his debts to Gletch. Gletch therefore paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to track Greenfinger down and kill him to make an example of him.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ToughThugMaleRodianTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Greenfinger]]
Examining this Rodian identified him as '''Greenfingers''', yet the quest dialogue referred to him as Greenfinger without the 's'. This article assumes the latter version is correct.
